title: Operations Associate
description:

🧩 What you bring
• 1-2 years in operations, logistics or a similar coordination role
• Comfortable with spreadsheets and basic formulas
• Business-fluent English (C1)
• German at B1 or above is a plus

A team that values clear communication and honest feedback
Learning budget of 1,000 EUR per year
30 days of vacation

* Build and maintain Looker dashboards for the operations leadership team

## You
* Strong SQL skills
* 2+ years in analytics, consulting or operations
* Looker or Tableau experience
* Professional English (C1)
* German (A2 or higher) is a bonus
